verdict.rationale: LangGraph has a first-party, documented LangGraph CLI that builds and runs the Agent Server locally, exposing API endpoints for runs, threads and assistants. A probe confirms the official CLI docs page, and a community post mentions running `langgraph serve` locally. missing for 10: a documented subcommand/command reference showing the CLI's breadth (e.g. build, deploy and scaffolding commands), independent hands-on evidence of CLI use beyond local serving, and evidence of CLI features aimed at agent-driven or AI-native workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: LangGraph CLI is a command-line tool for building and running the Agent Server locally.
The resulting server exposes all API endpoints for runs, threads, assistants, etc., and includes supporting services such as a managed database for checkpointing and storage.
